parts:
Hi Iñaki

Could I use this or something similar to leave a branch without leaving the whole trajectory? Am modelling a process that has two branches, the first time it should always go for the first one but then, with some probability related decision, it should leave and take the other branch. I have this up to now but it is not working:

LHD <- create_trajectory("Process") %>%
     set_attribute("Carga1", 0) %>%
     set_attribute("Carga1.2", 0) %>%
    set_attribute("HangUp",0) %>%
    set_attribute("Camino",1) %>%  # The first time will always go for the first path.
    
     branch(function(attrs) ifelse(attrs[["Camino"]]==1,1,2),c(T,T),
         create_trajectory("Branch1") %>%
         
       
         set_attribute("Carga1", function(attrs) attrs[["Carga1"]] + rnorm(1,19)) %>%   
         seize("Drawpoint1",1)   %>%
         timeout(function() rnorm(1,2)) %>%
         release("Drawpoint1",1) %>%
         seize("CamEx1",1)   %>%
         timeout(function() rnorm(1,10)) %>%
         release("CamEx1",1) %>%
         seize("Chanc",1)   %>%
         timeout(function() rnorm(1,5)) %>%
         release("Chanc",1)  %>%
         seize("CamEx1",1)   %>%
         timeout(function() rnorm(1,10)) %>%
         release("CamEx1",1) %>%
        set_attribute("HangUp", function(attrs) rnorm(1,10)) %>%       
        branch(function(attrs) ifelse(attrs[["HangUp"]]<9,1,2),c(T,T), # If HangUp is smaller than 9, then it should change the attribute "Camino" and then go back to the first branch and take the other path. Otherwise it only loses some time and goes back to the line where attribute "Carga1" is modified.


             create_trajectory("Alt1") %>%
                 set_attribute("Camino",2) %>%
                 rollback(amount=15,times=2),
             create_trajectory("Alt2") %>%
                 timeout(0.1)
             ) %>%
         rollback(amount=15, check=function(attrs) attrs[["Carga1"]] < 900),

         ........................

Currently my code is not doing what I want and am struggling to find a solution. Any advice would by appreciated.

Thanks a lot in advance.

Juan

messages.subject: Re: [simmer-devel] Re: New feature: leave a trajectory with some probability
parts:
Hi Juan, welcome to this list.

leave doesn’t help here. It does what it promises: the arrival leaves, is dropped. Instead, you only need to increment the first rollback to amount=17, and it will point to the first branch, so your problem is solved.

To debug these questions, you can print the trajectory, and you’ll see which activity the rollback is pointing to. For instance, let’s take the following trajectory. I’m going to change the amount to rollback (1, 2, 3) and print the trajectory. Note the last line of each print:

t <- create_trajectory() %>%
  seize("dummy", 1) %>%
  branch(function() 1, T, 
         create_trajectory() %>%
           timeout(1) %>%
           rollback(amount=1, 1))
t
#> simmer trajectory: anonymous, 4 activities
#> { Activity: Seize        | resource: dummy | amount: 1 }
#> { Activity: Branch       | option: 0x44b1468 }
#>   Fork 1, continue,  simmer trajectory: anonymous, 2 activities
#>   { Activity: Timeout      | delay: 1 }
#>   { Activity: Rollback     | amount: 1 (Timeout), times: 1 }
t <- create_trajectory() %>%
  seize("dummy", 1) %>%
  branch(function() 1, T, 
         create_trajectory() %>%
           timeout(1) %>%
           rollback(amount=2, 1))
t
#> simmer trajectory: anonymous, 4 activities
#> { Activity: Seize        | resource: dummy | amount: 1 }
#> { Activity: Branch       | option: 0x3ce6c58 }
#>   Fork 1, continue,  simmer trajectory: anonymous, 2 activities
#>   { Activity: Timeout      | delay: 1 }
#>   { Activity: Rollback     | amount: 2 (Branch), times: 1 }
t <- create_trajectory() %>%
  seize("dummy", 1) %>%
  branch(function() 1, T, 
         create_trajectory() %>%
           timeout(1) %>%
           rollback(amount=3, 1))
t
#> simmer trajectory: anonymous, 4 activities
#> { Activity: Seize        | resource: dummy | amount: 1 }
#> { Activity: Branch       | option: 0x4702610 }
#>   Fork 1, continue,  simmer trajectory: anonymous, 2 activities
#>   { Activity: Timeout      | delay: 1 }
#>   { Activity: Rollback     | amount: 3 (Seize), times: 1 }
​
